headline: Revenue surges but losses widen on quick-service push
summary_short: Urban Company's September-2026 quarter revenue was ₹537.29 crore (+41% y/y) but the net loss widened to ₹182.48 crore from ₹59.33 crore a year ago.
summary_long: Per press coverage, total expenses rose to ₹745.67 crore from ₹461.73 crore, outpacing revenue. The InstaHelp segment lost ₹173.12 crore on ₹20.54 crore of revenue. The board approved a fundraise of up to ₹2,500 crore, subject to shareholder approval. Figures come from news coverage, not the filing.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Numbers come from a trade-press article found by web search; other outlets quote adjusted EBITDA loss figures that this article does not, so none are shown. The exchange filing was not read. Loss deltas are computed as the change in loss versus the prior-year quarter.
